page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 2 physical cores with 1 thread per core, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading. The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, requiring external block storage for boot volumes and data.

Operating with a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is structured for entry-level compute-focused workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation provides predictable execution performance compared to shared-core alternatives, making it a cost-efficient option for lightweight applications that require stable CPU performance without the overhead of larger memory allocations. Appropriate workloads include lightweight web serving, basic microservices, small-scale utility applications, and development environments.
